metadata.title: Communications Action Plan
metadata.preparedFor: Advancing Together Communications Team, Black Hawk County Public Health, and partner organizations
metadata.shortPurpose: Improve accessibility of publicly available materials through shared tools, training, pilots, and sustainable communications routines.
metadata.purpose: This charter-style action plan guides the Advancing Together Communications Team, Black Hawk County Public Health, and partner organizations in implementing Economic Stability Strategy 11: educating community organizations on practices that improve the accessibility of publicly available materials. The plan moves from scoping and partner learning to practical tools, pilot implementation, and sustainability.
metadata.coalitionRole: The Communications Team and partners develop shared accessibility guidance, technical assistance, and repeatable processes for public-facing materials.

sections.title: Foundation and Scope
sections.summary: Confirm scope, audience, partner roles, gaps, and the most useful first-year product.

actions.title: Convene the Advancing Together Communications Team to confirm the Strategy 11 charter and first-year decision points.
responsibleParties: Northeast Iowa Food Bank and Pathways invited
keyTasks: Confirm quarterly meeting rhythm
clarify whether the first phase centers on basic accessibility practices, language access, cultural review, or all three
document the intended audience for the first product
successIndicators: Team confirms scope, meeting schedule, lead roles, and a short list of decisions needed by the end of Q2
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026.

actions.title: Review Community Partner Assessment findings to identify priority barriers, languages, and public material types.
keyTasks: Summarize translation, interpretation, accessibility, cost, time, technology, and staff capacity barriers
note common languages and areas with higher burden or people not currently reached
resources: partner knowledge about public-facing materials and service access barriers
successIndicators: A short data brief identifies priority gaps, partner needs, and 3-5 material types to focus on first
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026.

actions.title: Map existing communications infrastructure, authority, and resources that can support shared accessibility guidance.
keyTasks: Inventory Google Drive, Facebook group, BHCPH Advancing Together webpage, draft Advancing Together website, partner channels, and local government accessibility lessons
clarify who can approve and maintain public-facing resources
successIndicators: Resource map and maintenance owner options are documented before toolkit development begins
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q1: Jul-Sep 2026 - Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

actions.title: Hold targeted partner listening with organizations that understand language, disability, older adult, and low-literacy access barriers.
responsibleParties: older adult, disability-serving, immigrant/refugee, library, school, and adult education partners
keyTasks: Ask what would be most useful: training, toolkit, checklist, vendor list, peer examples, or online resource hub
gather examples of barriers created by online-only, small-print, untranslated, inaccessible PDF, video, image, or screenshot-only materials
successIndicators: At least 8 partner or community reviewer perspectives inform the first product choice and quick-win practices
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

sections.title: Tools and Shared Resources
sections.summary: Create practical tools for plain language, accessible public materials, language access, cultural review, and vendor navigation.

actions.title: Select the first shared product and define practical success measures for partner use.
keyTasks: Choose whether to build a toolkit, checklist, decision tree, vendor/resource list, training, repository, or combined starter package
set realistic measures for partner learning and material updates
successIndicators: First shared product, audience, success measures, and development timeline are approved
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026.

actions.title: Draft a beginner-friendly checklist and decision tree for public-facing materials.
keyTasks: Cover plain language, readability, accessible PDFs, websites, flyers, images, videos, social media posts, captions, alt text, large print, non-digital options, and public meeting materials
include quick wins such as avoiding screenshot-only flyers
resources: examples from Black Hawk County, Linn County, Johnson County, nonprofits, and community foundations
successIndicators: Draft checklist and decision tree are ready for partner review by the end of Q3
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q2: Oct-Dec 2026 - Q3: Jan-Mar 2027.

actions.title: Develop language access and cultural review guidance for translated materials.
responsibleParties: trained bilingual staff or qualified interpreters/translators
keyTasks: Identify priority language questions
explain when AI, Google Translate, bilingual staff, qualified translators, interpreters, or human cultural review may be appropriate
note risks, limits, and review steps
successIndicators: Guidance helps partners decide when translation, interpretation, or cultural review is needed for key materials
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027.

actions.title: Create a shared vendor, tool, and example list for accessibility, translation, interpretation, captioning, and document support.
responsibleParties: partner organizations willing to share vendors
web or communications vendors as available
keyTasks: Collect vendors, tools, pricing considerations, turnaround times, accessibility reviewers, web developers, captioning options, and examples of strong local materials
flag where group pricing may be possible
successIndicators: Vendor/resource list includes at least 10 usable entries and notes cost, service type, and practical considerations
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q3: Jan-Mar 2027 - Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Pilot the draft toolkit with a small group of organizations before broader release.
keyTasks: Ask pilot organizations to apply the checklist to one flyer, webpage, PDF, social media post, video, or public meeting material
document what is clear, what is too burdensome, and what requires funding or technical assistance
resources: possible translation or accessibility review costs
successIndicators: Pilot feedback produces concrete revisions and at least 3 materials are reviewed using the draft tool
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

sections.title: Pilot and Training
sections.summary: Pilot the tools with partner organizations, support material updates, and track whether people not currently reached are better considered.

actions.title: Host the first training or peer-learning session on accessible, plain-language, and language-accessible public materials.
keyTasks: Share the starter checklist, quick wins, decision tree, and examples
include accessible print, digital, social media, translated, and non-digital communication practices
successIndicators: At least 15 participants attend and post-session feedback shows increased confidence in creating accessible public materials
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q4: Apr-Jun 2027.

actions.title: Provide a first technical assistance cohort for organizations updating priority public materials.
responsibleParties: partner volunteers with accessibility or language access expertise
keyTasks: Support organizations in reviewing or revising materials that affect service access
prioritize plain language, readable layout, captions, alt text, accessible PDFs, translated materials, and non-digital options where needed
resources: Staff or volunteer technical assistance time
successIndicators: At least 6 organizations complete a material review and at least 10 public-facing materials are improved
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027 - Q6: Oct-Dec 2027.

actions.title: Collect user and community reviewer feedback on whether revised materials reduce barriers to information access.
keyTasks: Use brief feedback forms, partner conversations, or reviewer notes to assess clarity, language fit, readability, non-digital access, and usefulness for people not currently reached
successIndicators: Feedback identifies what changed, remaining barriers, and priorities for the next training cycle
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q6: Oct-Dec 2027.

actions.title: Expand training and peer examples to a broader group of community organizations.
responsibleParties: public libraries, schools/adult education providers, and nonprofit networks
keyTasks: Offer a second session or peer-learning forum
highlight practical examples from the cohort
promote through existing partner channels
invite organizations with cost, training, translation, and technology barriers
successIndicators: At least 25 additional participants are reached and 8 organizations commit to using the checklist or resource hub
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q7: Jan-Mar 2028.

sections.title: Resource Hub and Sustainability
sections.summary: Build the resource hub, refresh process, shared funding options, and ongoing quarterly reporting into Advancing Together routines.

actions.title: Launch a shared resource hub for accessibility, language access, and public material examples.
keyTasks: Post the checklist, decision tree, vendor/tool list, training slides, quick-win examples, and contact path through Google Drive, the BHCPH Advancing Together webpage, and/or future Advancing Together website
successIndicators: Resource hub is live, shared through partner channels, and has an identified maintainer
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q5: Jul-Sep 2027.

actions.title: Refresh toolkit content based on changing standards, partner use, and community language needs.
keyTasks: Review changes in governmental accessibility timelines and lessons
update priority language information
remove outdated tools
add examples of accessible print, digital, video, and meeting materials
successIndicators: Updated toolkit version is posted with a change log and partner notification
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q7: Jan-Mar 2028 - Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Explore shared funding, group pricing, or pooled vendor access for translation, interpretation, and accessibility support.
keyTasks: Assess partner demand, common service needs, likely costs, and possible funders
determine whether group rates, vendor agreements, or shared technical assistance are feasible
successIndicators: A feasibility memo identifies at least one viable shared resource or explains why individual partner approaches are more realistic
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q8: Apr-Jun 2028.

actions.title: Institutionalize a quarterly communications accessibility touchpoint and reporting process.
keyTasks: Add standing quarterly review of toolkit use, training reach, material updates, barriers, and partner needs
report progress to the Advancing Together coalition
successIndicators: Quarterly reporting process is in place and includes partner participation, materials updated, and barriers needing coalition attention
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q9: Jul-Sep 2028.

actions.title: Complete the 2028 review and sustainability plan for shared communications accessibility resources.
keyTasks: Review accomplishments, partner feedback, materials updated, resource hub use, training reach, and remaining gaps
confirm 2029 ownership, maintenance, funding, and coalition reporting needs
successIndicators: Final review documents progress and names owners, refresh schedule, and resource needs for sustaining the work beyond 2028
actions.publicUpdateNote: Initial action-plan row published from the FY26-28 Communications source materials. Implementation is scheduled for Q10: Oct-Dec 2028.
